uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes — silently falls back to category='business' with no error/notice, per the VALID_CATEGORIES.includes(...) ? ... : 'business' ternary in creators/page.tsx

getCategories/getCreators/getCourses/getGuides throw — no error.tsx exists under src/app/(app)/explore/, and explore.ts + learn.ts are pure-mock-delegation (no try/fetch-then-mock fallback, unlike auth/content/notifications/purchases/search), so any real-backend failure here has no screen-authored handling at all
uiStatesHandled.reachable: no — mock functions never throw under the current mock-driven app, so this path is never exercised today; it is a genuine gap for when a real backend replaces the mock
